raw_answer_text:
Looking at the validation errors, the issue is clear: I'm missing the `block` keyword that should precede each component declaration. The `block` genre requires an explicit keyword to declare each block/component.

The corrected syntax follows this pattern: `block <id> "<label>"`

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

block poller "Poller"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block healthprobe "Health Probe"
block buffer "Ring Buffer"
block exporter "Exporter"

poller -> normalizer
healthprobe -> normalizer
normalizer -> buffer
buffer -> exporter
```

The key changes:
- Added `block` keyword before each component id (lines 5-9)
- Kept the labels in quotes as required
- Left the edges/connections unchanged—they correctly reference the block ids
- Title and figdown declaration remain the same

The edges now correctly connect the five components: poller and healthprobe feed into the normalizer, which feeds into the buffer, which feeds into the exporter.
